mutations.name: the raw-line scan is replaced by a scan that skips fenced lines
mutations.replace: text.split("\n").filter((line, at, lines) => lines.slice(0, at).filter((earlier) => earlier.trim().startsWith("```")).length % 2 === 0).map(authorityReading)

mutations.name: the label fold is removed for an exact Authority: prefix
